# Creel — Task & Design Notes

Recreation of ColorLib Accordion 12 (`accordion-12`).

## Section Structure

1. **Header / Navbar**: Brand title, navigation links (Features, FAQ, Support, Contact), CTA button.
2. **Hero Section**: Catchy headline ("Frequently Asked Questions & Interactive Accordion Showcase"), subtitle, search bar.
3. **Category Tabs**: Filter tabs for organizing accordion topics.
4. **Accordion Showcase**: Main collapsible sections with number badges, icons, smooth expand/collapse behavior.
5. **Call to Action / Support Banner**: Prompt users with questions to reach out.
6. **Footer**: Copyright, quick links, branded Component Dock link (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Fidelity Checklist

- [ ] Brand colors and typography match tokens.
- [ ] Accordion expand/collapse works with smooth animation.
- [ ] Footer links to Component Dock.
- [ ] No mention of ColorLib in code.
